note: Latest election per category - results are static once published. DUN = the latest state election for EVERY state: 10 states come from the pru-dun dropdown (Negeri Sembilan KE-16, Johor KE-16, Sabah KE-17, Sarawak KE-12, Melaka KE-15, and 2023 elections in Kedah/Kelantan/Penang/Selangor/Terengganu); Perlis, Perak and Pahang held their state elections with PRU-15 and come from its DUN payload. SPR's getParDun omits Kedah P.017 Padang Serai (2023 by-election seat), and the 13 federal-territory seats (KL/Putrajaya/Labuan) have no state entry in SPR's dropdown, so PRU-15 is 208 seats here vs 222 nationally.
